# Vendored validator

`validator.cc` is copied verbatim, byte for byte, from the `potassco/teaspoon` repository.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Source | <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/potassco/teaspoon/master/bin/validator.cc> |
| Repository | <https://github.com/potassco/teaspoon> |
| Commit | `bf332c166b7019ea923559071928dc321e1559f4` |
| SHA-256 | `6dd906a4f2f1d1e6e8d4e74b76676daa46d8f05c001ff02f54fd570331dc5452` |
| Retrieved | 2026-08-31 |
| Upstream licence | MIT (`LICENSE` at the repository root) |
| Authors | Andrea Schaerf, Luca Di Gaspero (University of Udine), 13 March 2008 |

Do not edit this file. It is the ground truth for the UD1–UD5 cost definitions; editing it
would destroy the only independent check the project has. If it must change, replace it with
a newer upstream copy and update the hash above.

Verify the copy at any time with:

    sha256sum -c <<< "6dd906a4f2f1d1e6e8d4e74b76676daa46d8f05c001ff02f54fd570331dc5452  external/validator/validator.cc"

Build it with `make validator`; run it as `./external/validator/validator UD1 <instance.ectt> <solution.sol>`.
